storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Flirt4Free Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and save video recordings from Flirt4Free.com.

How it works: Go to any model's room on Flirt4Free. If the model is live, click Start to begin capturing the stream. Click Stop when you're done. For recorded videos in a model's gallery, select quality and click Download. The extension handles HLS stream capture and converts everything to standard MP4 files.

It handles Flirt4Free's LL-HLS streaming, Mouflon-encoded playlists, and multi-CDN delivery automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized FLIRT4FREE subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream capture with start/stop controls
- Download recorded videos from model galleries
- Multi-CDN stream discovery (doppiocdn, stripcdnm, sc-cdn, and more)
- VR stream support with proper metadata handling
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Real-time download progress with segment counter for live captures
- Right-click context menu for quick access
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Flirt4Free.com and open a model's room
3. Click Start in the popup or in-page button to capture a live stream
4. Click Stop when done — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Open a model's room on Flirt4Free.com while they're live. Click the extension icon or in-page button, select quality, and click Start. Click Stop when you want to end the recording.

faq.question: Can I download recorded videos too?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a model's video gallery page and the extension will detect available recordings. Select quality and click Download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension parses the HLS master manifest and shows all available quality variants — typically multiple resolutions. For VOD, source MP4 or HLS variants are offered.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a FLIRT4FREE subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: Does this support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR camera settings and includes VR metadata in the filename (stereoPacking, frame format, angle).

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding the stream?
faq.answer: The model must be live and in a public show. Private shows and offline models are not accessible. If issues persist, refresh the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
